english.title: Insider dealer disclosing information
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having information as an insider, disclosed that information, otherwise than in the proper performance of the functions of your employment, office or profession, to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 52(2)(b) and 61(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 1993.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Secretary of State or the Director of Public Prosecutions is required before proceedings may commence.
(ii) SI 2021/1173 amended the penalty for this offence with effect from 1st November 2021. For an offence that is committed before that date use this offence wording. For an offence that is committed after that date, use H23075.
(iii) Where an offence is found to be committed over a period of two or more days, or at some point during a period of two or more days, it is to be taken to have been committed on the first of those days, see section 31(4) of the Financial Services Act 2021.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
